item.title: Sightseeing trip to Lac Léman
item.description:
After the great success of the excursion to Ticino last autumn, we are bringing you another sightseeing tour. This time, we will explore the beauty of the banks of Lac Léman in the french-speaking canton of Vaud. We will start our trip by visiting the Château de Chillon (entrance fee 12,5 Fr. for students). Then we will move to nearby Montreux where we will check out the lake promenade with a famous statue of Freddie Mercury. For lunch, we will grab some food in the centre. Afterwards we will embark on a boat to get back to the city of Lausanne while admiring the characteristic vineyards (even part of the UNESCO World Heritage) from the surface of the lake. In Lausanne we can stroll through the city centre and visit the cathedral or the Olympia museum.

Connections:

We are going to take a train from Zürich HB at 7:19 with a change in Lausanne and we are going to arrive in Veytaux-Chillon at 10:24. Connection Link

There are direct trains from Lausanne back to Zurich every 30 minutes. We will decide on the spot which one we will take. Duration of the way back is approximately 2,5 hours.

Tickets:

Note that the tickets for trains etc. are not going to be organized collectively. We are going to travel a lot, so it pays off to buy a day pass (Tageskarte). It allows for flexibility and is valid for boats, as well. There is either the Spartageskarte possibly combined with Halbtax, which has to be purchased in advance and whose price grows with time, or the Friends-Tageskarte Jugend, which has a fixed price of 80 Fr. and can be used by up to 4 persons under the age of 25 (max 24,99), i.e. if 4 people share one ticket, each one has to pay 20 Fr. only. You can use the WhatsApp group (see below) to arrange the ticket with others.

Communication:

There is a WhatsApp group for any news & meeting arrangements: Link to join WhatsApp

item.title: Hot dogs (Párek v rohlíku)
item.description:
Do you also reminisce of the old days when life seemed oh so simple? 😌 When afternoons were filled with exploration and little adventures. One of those childhood adventures might just have been grabbing a hot dog otherwise known as “párek v rohlíku” and sitting in the sun talking about what cartoon you are going to watch when you get home.

If you want to experience a small taste of the past alongside that of a real párek v rohlíku (and Czech beer 🍻, of course), then you are wholeheartedly invited to come to this transformative experience, bring your friends and loved ones, it will be a feast unlike anything UZH has seen before.

We will be making the hot dogs in the UZH KOL kitchen with a possibility of moving the event to the outside if the weather were to be nice.

Do not forget to register in the Google Form, as there will only be a limited number of hot dogs available, first come 🏃‍♀️, first serve 🌭!

item.title: Pub Quiz 💡
item.description:
🎉 Brain-teasing night with your favourite people from CSSZ! Join us for yet another Pub Quiz night on March 30th at the Cooper’s Pub in Oerlikon! 🍻

🏆 Put your knowledge to the test and compete with friends or make new ones as you tackle a wide range of exciting and diverse questions. From pop culture and history to sports and general knowledge, there’s something for everyone.

item.title: Slunečný pofel @ Bqm
item.description:
Join us for Slunečný pofel at the bQm bar! ☀️ Whether you want to take a break from your studies or just catch up with the Czech and Slovak community in Zurich over a beer, this is the place to be 🍻.

It’s a great chance to meet new faces and enjoy the relaxed atmosphere of bQm. We look forward to seeing you all there! 🎉
